description.blurb: 37655 Illapa is a carbonaceous asteroid, classified as a near-Earth object and iapproximately 1.5 kilometers in diameter.
description.more: Discovered in 1994, Illapa has a short rotation period of 2.6556 hours. On 16 August 2003, Illapa made a close approach to Earth of 0.025037 AU (3,750,000 km; 2,330,000 mi, or about 10 lunar distances).
